question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error in phrasal verb.

Tina dropped behind of / college and / went straight / into a good job.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the phrasal verb "**dropped behind of**".
 
• The correct phrasal verb should be "**dropped out of**".
 
• The phrase "dropped out of" means to leave a school or college before completing the course.
